summary: Atmos Energy Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a public offering of $700 million aggregate principal amount of 4.750% Senior Notes due 2032. The offering was registered under a Form S-3 shelf registration statement. Net proceeds to the company were approximately $693.9 million after underwriting discount and expenses. The notes are unsecured senior obligations ranking equally with existing unsubordinated debt, issued under a base indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee. Interest is payable semi-annually, and the company may redeem the notes at its option. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
